title: clawdhub campaign published agent skills impersonating the ClawHub CLI
summary: A ClawHub account named zaycv published skills posing as an official CLI for managing agent skills, whose SKILL.md told the agent to install a prerequisite by base64-decoding a command that curled a script from a bare IP address into bash and to fetch a password-protected archive named openclaw-core. Snyk found the original clawhub skill on 2 February 2026 with 7,743 downloads and it was removed the next day, after which near-identical variants appeared and the same openclaw-core prerequisite trap turned up in google-qx4, a skill impersonating a Google services integration.
severity_rationale: Remote code execution delivered as natural-language setup instructions that the agent relays to the user, inheriting whatever the agent is permitted to run.
